subject: environmental-science

items.q: Is protecting one species enough to save an ecosystem?
items.correct: No — ecosystems depend on many interacting species and habitats.
items.misconception: Yes, saving one species protects everything.
items.random_wrong: Human population size has no environmental effect.
items.why: Conservation must protect whole habitats and food webs, not single species in isolation.

items.q: Why does a growing human population strain the environment?
items.correct: It increases demand for resources, land and energy, and adds waste/emissions.
items.misconception: It has no effect on the environment.
items.why: Rising consumption pressures ecosystems through habitat loss, pollution and resource use.
